atv-trails.geojson.query: where 1=1, geometry = WBD HUC8 07010102 polygon, spatialRel=esriSpatialRelIntersects; ATV split atv_class_1='X' OR atv_class_2='X' (ORV-only rides with ATV per ITM rule)
atv-trails.geojson.caveats: DNR OHV Trails service, designated ATV/UTV trails only. A feature is in this file iff atv_class_1 or atv_class_2 is 'X' (ITM rule); ORV (4x4)-only features ride with the ATV file. OHM-only features are NOT here (count recorded above). This is designated trails only -- NOT the NCT ATV-proposal work (proposed trails near the North Country Trail); no proposed route is drawn. Geometries are clipped to the HUC8 boundary, so a trail crossing the boundary is cut; the `miles` field is the FULL segment length and can exceed the drawn clipped length. funding_type distinguishes state vs Grant-in-Aid (see counts). Feature count matches the live returnCountOnly count for the OHV service; the ATV split is applied after the pull.
